datum_motion.relation: StrokePosition = 35 + 1000*q for q in m. Hard stops at 0 and 740 mm.

cylinder_frame.relation: Fixed pin centers x=490 mm. Pins run along Z and carry signed reactions.

rod_grip.relation: Moving pin centers x=1650+stroke mm. Reversible double-shear connection.

grip_transfer.relation: Two clevises located at variant cylinder axes. Use signed per-branch force and arm about Y or Z.

transfer_carrier.relation: Primary plate x=(1800..2140)+stroke mm, 1200 mm effective strip width. Guide arms and spider move together.

carrier_punch.relation: Compression at x=2140+stroke mm and reverse retention at x=1800+stroke via collar and four ties. Punch face x=2930+stroke; local collar connection section 360 x 270 mm.

carrier_guides.relation: Opposed pads at x=1915+stroke and 2515+stroke mm. Use 0.5 mm nominal guide running gap and 0.75 mm additional radial fit budget at the chamber.

guides_frame.relation: Guide faces at ±1050 mm on the relevant axis. Elastic 520 x 700 mm strips supported at x=340 and 3845 mm. Check PIN_PIN and FIXED_FIXED.

material_reaction.relation: 300 x 220 mm punch, 311 x 231 mm chamber passage, die inlet at x=3685 mm (A) or 3740 mm (B), outlet 150 x 60 mm nominal product. Source axial paths and eccentricities apply.

reaction_frame.relation: Four frame ties at y/z=±1250 mm. Fixed seats and key backings bear axially on the reaction head. Foundation and fixture stiffness are unknown.

sections_stability.relation: Gland end x=1500 mm and rod pin x=1650+stroke mm. Guide and tie span 3505 mm. Free punch length 790 mm. Use scoped sections and assumed material limits.

envelopes_service.relation: Native hard and operating poses plus running clearances are in the assembly manifest. Rear extraction allowance is a design requirement pending full service study.

receiver_cycle.relation: B chamber stop closed through 501.389 mm working stroke. For key load use axial take-up 0.50 mm at the stop and 0.25 mm at the keys. Seat-only take-up is 2.50 mm with keys lowered. Unload and reset take-ups, lower keys 700 mm, then raise stop 485 mm before further advance.

known_changes_for_r3: Read signed force split about the centerline and exceptional imbalance instead of the old single-cylinder arm.
